name: functions
description: IHM TMS REST API — Express on Cloud Functions (2nd gen).

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n build,emu -c yellow,magenta "node esbuild.mjs --watch" "firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --import ../.emulator-data --export-on-exit ../.emulator-data"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.emulate:smoke: npm run build && node esbuild.mjs --seed && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ihm-tms --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node functions/lib/seed.js && node functions/scripts/smoke.mjs"
